known_limits: Under the host's real systemd PID 1, systemd-analyze accepted copies of the shipped units after ExecStart was redirected to /bin/true, and a synthetic inert unit passed start/restart/stop; this does not prove the shipped binaries or a native installer transaction. Installer fresh-install/upgrade/rollback/purge mutations remain isolated test-root evidence.
No native Windows PowerShell, Windows Service, ACL/Defender, or router/data-path runtime evidence; Windows remains build-only.

No native arm64 or OpenRC host evidence. arm64 verification is limited to Agent, CLI, and installer package compilation; full arm64 command builds remain blocked by the pre-existing internal/hook/sandbox_linux.go SYS_FORK/SYS_VFORK architecture issue.

Docker evidence is limited to local amd64 image builds and static inspection. Local image IDs are not registry manifest digests; no SBOM, signature, or production host-network runtime evidence is claimed. syft and cosign are unavailable.
The smoke release uses a generated test Ed25519 key and local artifacts. Production release artifact pinning, SBOM/signature, and exact image/artifact digest approval remain P19 work.
The full repository suite requires the provisioned ANTINAT_DEDICATED_UID=12001 and ANTINAT_DEDICATED_GID=12001 environment; no native platform support promotion is claimed.

Installer values for bind interface, log level, auto-update, detection scheduler, and GitHub proxy are persisted in agent.conf, but the current Agent runtime consumes only endpoint/state/node/token/pin/STUN/auto-order; Windows services also do not load agent.conf. These options are not runtime-enforced by this P18 implementation, and application changes are out of scope.
govulncheck was unavailable and was not recorded as PASS.
No public-WAN, real-router, or native platform support promotion is claimed.
